name: Rep Reaction Atlas
blurb: Dispatch-office card table, not a game region: a faction-reputation scrubber that restages the shipping radio/HUD bark pipeline against a scripted ten-band survey ride. Sliders stand in for guild/choir/reclaimers standing from hostile to kin; the bench shows which voices key up, which surfaces stay silent (gates, prices, callouts), and flags coverage gaps for the writers. Anchors and center live outside the playable map.
